description:
**Job Description :**

**About us**

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.

Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.

Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

**About the Function:**

  

Our Digital and Technology (D&T) team are innovators, delivering ground-breaking solutions that will help shape the future of our iconic brands. Technology touches every part of our business, from the sourcing of sustainable ingredients to marketing and development of our online platforms. We utilise data insights to build competitive advantage, supporting our people to deliver value faster.

Our D&T team includes some of the most talented digital professionals in the industry. Every day, we come together to push boundaries and innovate, shaping the digital solutions of tomorrow. Whatever your passion, we’ll help you become the best you can be, creating career-defining work and delivering breakthrough thinking.

**About the role:**

Lead the engineering capability required to build and evolve reliable Commercial data solutions using reusable patterns, automated controls and product-aligned delivery. The role is accountable for engineering quality, delivery discipline and technical outcomes; product priorities and business value remain with product owners.

**Core skills required on a broader prospective -**

Years of exp - 3 to 10 years

  

Below technical capabilities the Analytical Product Manager/Owner need to possess the areas marked as #1 is non-negotiable in context of requirements:

Data & Analytics Foundations (#1)

* SQL proficiency for querying, validating and exploring data
* Understanding of data modelling (star/snowflake schemas, dimensional modelling)
* Familiarity with KPI design, metric definitions and semantic layers
* Statistical literacy (A/B testing, significance, forecasting basics)

Data Platforms & Architecture ( Foundational understanding of aspects as part of Product/Solution Architecture and its implications)

* Knowledge of modern data stacks: cloud data warehouses and lakehouses (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Azure Synapse/Fabric)
* Understanding of ETL/ELT pipelines and orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow, Azure Data Factory)
* Awareness of data integration from ERP/CRM sources (e.g. SAP, Salesforce, Workday)
* APIs and data exchange principles

BI & Visualisation (previous experience required as this is capabilities/capacity would be provided from BI Transformation & Self-Service pillar)

* Hands-on experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Qlik)
* Dashboard design and data storytelling best practice
* Self-service analytics enablement

Data Governance & Quality (#1)

* Data quality frameworks, lineage and cataloguing (Collibra, Informatica, Alation)
* Master data management principles
* Data privacy and regulatory awareness
* Access control and security models

Advanced Analytics & AI (#1)

* Understanding of machine learning lifecycle and MLOps concepts
* Ability to scope predictive and prescriptive use cases
* Awareness of GenAI applications in analytics

Product Management Tooling & Methods (#1)

* Agile/Scrum delivery and backlog management (Jira, Azure DevOps)
* Writing user stories, acceptance criteria and data requirements
* Product roadmapping, prioritisation frameworks (RICE, MoSCoW)
* Product usage analytics and adoption tracking

Business Translation & Thought Leadership (#1)

* Functional use case formulation: identifying, defining and shaping analytics use cases with business functions (e.g. Supply Chain, Finance, Commercial)
* Translating business problems into technical requirements (BRDs including NFRs)
* Thought leadership: shaping the analytics vision for functional analytics products, advocating data-driven decision-making in context of the process the product is supporting and bringing an informed view on industry trends and emerging capabilities to evolve the product offering
* Value measurement and benefits tracking for analytics products
* Stakeholder management across business, GBS Data Office and GBS Product experience Towers

ML or GenAI solutions

Data science

HCB is the leading industrial disruptor, building and connecting software solutions to streamline and centralize the assets, people and processes that help our customers make smarter, more accurate business decisions. Moving at the speed of software, we are creating, innovating and delivering solutions fast, challenging the way things have always been done, piloting new ways for all of us to work, and expecting our successes to set new standards for our customers and for Honeywell.

  

YOU MUST HAVE

* Business analysis in a complex and Cross-Functional Stakeholder environment

* Overall 6+ years of software development experience

* 4+ years’ experience in Agile development environments as a Product Owner/Business Analyst

title: Product Manager II - DAU Labs
description:
**About the Team**
------------------

Meesho is the most downloaded e-commerce app in India. As part of the core Business and Product Experience team, we are taking a massive leap from a purely transactional e-commerce platform to a destination for visual discovery and personal inspiration.

We are building an immersive feed inside the Meesho app, focused on look-based, trend-based, and highly personalized inspiration across major lifestyle categories like Fashion, Home, and Beauty.

The DAU Labs team focuses on building engaging discovery experiences, scaling content supply, and solving complex personalization and ranking problems to drive user engagement, daily active users (DAU), and long-term retention.

**About the Role**
------------------

As a Product Manager II at DAU Labs, you will play a key role in building and scaling Meesho's content-led discovery experience. You will work on creating engaging and personalized product experiences that help millions of users discover relevant trends, products, and inspiration.

You will own key product problems across content discovery, personalization, user engagement, and conversion. Working closely with Engineering, Data Science, Design, and Business teams, you will identify opportunities, drive product improvements, and deliver measurable impact on DAU growth and user retention.

### **What you will do**

* **Product Strategy & Ownership:** Own key product areas within the content discovery ecosystem, identify user and business problems, and define product roadmaps aligned with DAU growth objectives.
* **Discovery & Personalization:** Work on improving content discovery, feed relevance, recommendation systems, and personalization to deliver engaging experiences tailored to different user cohorts.
* **User Engagement & Growth:** Identify opportunities to improve user engagement, daily active usage, session frequency, and long-term retention through data-driven product initiatives.
* **Experimentation & Analytics:** Drive product experiments, A/B testing, and data analysis to identify growth opportunities, measure product performance, and continuously improve user experience.
* **Product Execution:** Work closely with Engineering, Design, and Data Science teams to translate business problems into product requirements and drive end-to-end execution.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with Content, Category Marketing, Seller Experience, and other business teams to improve content quality, discovery, and content-to-commerce conversion.
* **0-to-1 Problem Solving:** Identify new opportunities, solve ambiguous product problems, and build scalable product solutions that create meaningful user and business impact

### **What you will need**

* **Experience:** Overall experience of 4+ years, with at least 4+ years of experience in Product Management in a tech-led company. Experience in B2C or consumer internet companies is preferred.
* **Product & Domain Expertise:** Experience working on consumer-facing products, content-led platforms, discovery experiences, recommendation systems, personalization, or engagement-focused products is preferred.
* **Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills:** Strong analytical aptitude with the ability to solve complex and ambiguous problems related to user discovery, engagement, personalization, and product growth.
* **Execution Bias:** Strong bias for action and execution, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver outcomes in a fast-paced environment.
* **Data-Driven Mindset:** Ability to use data, user insights, and experimentation to identify opportunities, make product decisions, and measure outcomes.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Ability to work effectively with Engineering, Design, Data Science, and Business teams to drive product initiatives end to end.
* **Mindset:** Strong passion for Problem First Solving (PFS), ownership, and building scalable products from 0 to 1.

### **About us**

Welcome to Meesho, where every story begins with a spark of inspiration and a dash of entrepreneurial spirit. We're not just a platform; we're your partner in turning dreams into realities.

**Curious about life at Meesho? Explore our Glassdoor - our people have a lot to say and they've helped us become a loved workplace in India.**

### **Our Mission**

Democratising internet commerce for everyone — Meesho (Meri Shop) started with a single idea in mind: to be an e-commerce destination for Indian consumers and to enable small businesses to succeed online.

We provide our sellers with benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping solutions in the market. Today, sellers nationwide are growing their businesses by tapping into Meesho’s large and diverse customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, and pan-India logistics network through trusted third-party partners.

Affordable, relatable merchandise that mirrors local markets has helped us connect with internet users and serve customers across urban, semi-urban, and rural India. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have established us as a part of India’s e-commerce ecosystem.

### **Culture and Total Rewards**

Our focus is on cultivating a dynamic workplace characterized by high impact and performance excellence. We prioritize a people-centric culture, dedicated to hiring and developing exceptional talent.

Total rewards at Meesho comprise a comprehensive set of elements — monetary, non-monetary, tangible, and intangible. Our 9 guiding principles, or "Mantras," are the backbone of how we operate, influencing everything from recognition and evaluation to growth discussions. Daily rituals and processes like “Problem First Mindset,” “Listen or Die,” our Internal Mobility Program, Talent Reviews, and Continuous Performance Management embody these principles.

We offer competitive compensation — both cash and equity-based — tailored to job roles, individual experience, and skill, along with employee-centric benefits and a supportive work environment. Our holistic wellness program, MeeCare, includes benefits across physical, mental, financial, and social wellness. This includes extensive medical insurance for employees and their families, wellness initiatives like telehealth, wellness events, and fitness-related perks.

To support work-life balance, we offer generous leave policies, parental support, retirement benefits, and learning and development assistance. Through personalized recognition, gratitude for stretched work, and engaging activities, we promote employee delight at the workplace. Additional benefits such as salary advance support, relocation assistance, and flexible benefit plans further enrich the Meesho experience.

At Meesho, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace where every individual can thrive. In compliance with the **Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016**, we uphold the following principles:

* **Equal Opportunity**: We ensure that employment opportunities are never denied on the grounds of disability if the candidate is otherwise competent to perform the job.
* **Accessible Workplace**: Our facilities are designed to be fully accessible, with amenities and assistive devices provided to support differently abled individuals in their work.
* **Inclusive Hiring Process**: We adopt a transparent and non-discriminatory selection process, including providing application forms in alternate formats and offering reasonable accommodations during interviews upon request.
* **Career Growth**: We provide adequate training post-recruitment and pre-promotion, with training materials available in accessible formats to enable equal career progression.
* **Support & Confidentiality**: A dedicated liaison officer/committee addresses concerns and grievances, while maintaining strict confidentiality of disability-related information.
* **Awareness & Inclusion**: We conduct awareness programs to promote a culture of inclusivity across the organization.

Meesho welcomes applicants and employees of all abilities and is dedicated to fostering an environment where differently abled persons can achieve their full potential.

Know more about Meesho here : https://www.meesho.io/

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Future Begins Here At Takeda, we are leading digital evolution and global transformation. By building innovative solutions and future-ready capabilities, we are meeting the need of patients, our people, and the planet.

Bengaluru, the city, which is India’s epicentre of Innovation, has been selected to be home to Takeda’s recently launched Innovation Capability Centre. We invite you to join our digital transformation journey. In this role, you will have the opportunity to boost your skills and become the heart of an innovative engine that is contributing to global impact and improvement.

**Position Overview: Product Owner – Content Generation**  
We are seeking a dynamic and driven Product Owner to lead the development and continuous improvement of enterprise content generation capabilities within Takeda’s global Content Innovation ecosystem, including AssembleIQ (Shaman) and any future content generation platforms. The ideal candidate will own the day-to-day product lifecycle, translating business and platform priorities into clear requirements and driving them end-to-end across business stakeholders, vendors, engineering and dependent platform teams. This role also includes ensuring the platforms continue to meet evolving business needs, driving adoption and operational improvements, and identifying opportunities to continuously improve the products, AI-enabled authoring tools and user experience.

**Key Responsibilities:**to be successful in this position, the candidate should be skilful perform the following responsibilities:

**Product Development**

* Experience with content generation and authoring platforms such as AssembleIQ (Shaman), including AI-assisted content creation tools, is strongly preferred.
* Contribute to product strategy and roadmap development and translate agreed platform priorities into executable product requirements.
* Define product offerings in terms of benefits, features, and customer journeys.
* Prioritize features for the product roadmap in collaboration with business stakeholders, platform leadership, vendors and development teams.
* Write and manage a backlog of epics, features and user stories, prioritizing items to achieve business goals.
* Own the evaluation and definition of product requirements, ensuring business needs, dependencies, acceptance criteria and expected outcomes are clearly understood before implementation.
* Ensure the team correctly understands the requirements.
* Collaborate closely with business, engineering, platform teams, vendors and other stakeholders across the content ecosystem.
* Align timelines, dependencies, and scope with the scrum master, engineering manager, Platform Manager, vendors and dependent teams.
* Participate in planning sprints to reaffirm priorities and confirm requirements.
* Actively participate in Agile delivery ceremonies and remain engaged throughout implementation to clarify requirements, resolve functional questions and validate delivered functionality.
* Oversee continuous improvement efforts.
* Identify and drive cross-platform dependencies and alignment across the broader content ecosystem, including content generation and authoring platforms, AI creation tools, DAM, taxonomy/metadata, integrations and downstream capabilities.
* Build strong relationships with business stakeholders and platform users; proactively gather needs and feedback, facilitate decisions and manage expectations throughout the product lifecycle.
* Act as the day-to-day product contact for the platform and independently drive topics from initial business need through evaluation, requirements, delivery and adoption.

**Vendor Management**

* Act as the primary day-to-day product interface with external technology vendors.
* Translate Takeda business needs into actionable vendor requirements and product enhancement requests for AssembleIQ (Shaman) and other content generation platforms.
* Drive vendor actions, functional issues and roadmap discussions through to resolution.
* Understand the vendor product roadmap and identify opportunities relevant to Takeda’s platform strategy and user needs.
* Ensure agreed vendor deliverables and outcomes meet business and product expectations.

**Content Generation Platform Management**

* Collaborate on product vision, roadmap and own day-to-day delivery for AssembleIQ (Shaman) and any future content generation platforms and tools.
* Define and prioritize capabilities that enable efficient, consistent and scalable content creation, including builders, templates, modular content, reusable blocks, localization and global-to-local adaptation.
* Help to drive requirements and adoption of AI-enabled content generation capabilities (such as generative drafting, translation and smart content), ensuring governed and responsible use.
* Evaluate, pilot and recommend new content generation and design tools as business needs evolve, including fit, gaps, cost and integration with the existing ecosystem.
* Define and manage integrations between content generation platforms and enterprise content, asset and channel systems to enable channel-ready output (for example email, CLM, landing pages and digital banners).
* Partner with markets, brand teams, content production partners and global teams to onboard users, gather feedback and expand platform use across markets and business units.

**Release and Deployment Management:**

* Contribute to release planning by defining business priorities, dependencies, functional readiness and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with engineering and platform teams to ensure functionality is ready for release and relevant business dependencies are addressed.
* Support successful releases through functional validation, stakeholder readiness and communication.

**Post-Launch Operations and Continuous Improvement:**

* Implement structured processes for collecting and addressing user feedback.
* Partner with technical teams to identify and address platform performance, reliability and user-experience issues.
* Monitor platform usage, adoption, user feedback and relevant product performance indicators to identify improvement opportunities.
* Actively contribute to and ensure appropriate product, process and user documentation is maintained.
* Provide training and support materials for users and relevant support teams.
* Proactively identify operational issues and improvement opportunities and drive them to resolution with the appropriate internal or external teams.
* Support rollout and adoption of new capabilities across markets and business units.

**Critical Knowledge and Skills: Specialized Skills:**

* Product Development & Delivery

* Backlog, Epic & Story Management
* Agile Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and DevOps Tools & Methodologies

description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 7 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from concept to launch.
* Experience with Growth in a fast paced environment (especially in Consumer facing Mobile first areas).
* Experience and interest in building large-scale platforms.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  

As a Product Manager leading the Transit and Mobile Recharge verticals within Google Pay (GPay) India, you will own the overall direction, strategy, and execution for two of GPay's highest-frequency engagement drivers. In this role, you will define end-to-end product roadmaps across daily-commute transit experiences as well as Mobile Recharge product strategy and growth across - Platform, AI experiences, UX, performance and more. You will serve as the core strategic owner bridging product innovation, internal cross-functional execution (Engineering, UX, Analytics, Legal, Business Development), and critical external ecosystem partnerships with Telecom companies, Aggregators, regulators, public transport operators, and more to scale daily and monthly usage and engagement amongst users across India.

Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Define and execute the multi-year product strategy for Transit and Mobile Recharge verticals on GPay India, translating complex daily utility needs and regulatory standards into intuitive, high-scale GPay experiences.
* Lead the end to end product portfolio across Growth, Platformization, Scalability, Reliability, Obsersability, AI experiences and new opportunities at massive scale.
* Lead buildout of the Transit space on GPay —driving initiatives across NCMC, QR Ticketing and other first-party and third-party experiences.
* Establish a close working relationship with key ecosystem partners (NPCI, Bharat Connect, aggregators, issuers and others) to navigate compliance , unblock technical dependencies, and lead cross-functional growth tracks to eliminate funnel friction and maximize user engagement.

title: Product Manager III, InsurTech (Risk Based Intelligence)
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

**Product Manager III, InsurTech (Risk Intelligence & Scoring)**  
  
  
**About the Product Team**  
  
The Product Team creates high-quality end-to-end experiences for travellers, partners, and Expedia Group. Our focus on customer-centric innovation enables us to develop products that build loyalty and repeat business. We partner closely with teams across Expedia Group to drive growth and achieve results for our customers and the company.
  
  
**About InsurTech and this role**  
  
The InsurTech Product team creates peace of mind so travellers can book and travel with confidence. This role sits at the intersection of InsurTech, FinTech, Data Science, and Platform Product Management, focusing on **Risk Intelligence and Scoring** .
  
  
Y

ou will help define and build the risk signals, predictive models, decisioning services, and scoring capabilities that power protection and fintech products across Expedia Group brands. These capabilities will enable accurate risk assessment, pricing optimization, underwriting decisions, fraud and loss mitigation, and monetization strategies that account for inventory arbitrage, pricing volatility, and demand fluctuations.
  
  
Working closely with Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, and business stakeholders, you will shape the foundational platforms, integrations, and operating models that allow our protection and financial products to scale globally, remain compliant across markets, and deliver sustainable business growth. Your success will come from simplifying complex systems, unlocking new platform capabilities, and using data-driven insights to drive better commercial and traveler outcomes.
  
  
**In this role, you will**

  

* Own the strategy, roadmap, execution, and adoption of **Risk Intelligence and Scoring** capabilities, including risk signals, predictive scores, and decisioning services that support protection and fintech products across Expedia Group brands and markets.
* Define product strategies that optimize pricing decisions, product recommendations, inventory utilization, risk-adjusted profitability, and demand predictability.
* Identify opportunities to leverage data, AI, and machine learning to improve risk assessment, predictive decisioning, commercial optimization, and product performance.
* Translate product strategy into clear requirements, prioritization frameworks, and execution plans while managing dependencies across multiple teams and complex platform initiatives.

description:
**Company Description**

**Purpose of the role**

Bosch Mobility Platform and Solutions (MPS) builds software platforms and digital services for the mobility ecosystem: tolling and traffic, logistics and fleets, commerce and marketplaces, financial services, and the cloud and data platform that runs underneath them. MPS works with partners and customers across India, Europe and North America, and operates like a digital-native business inside Bosch.

Toll.OS is the open-road tolling and traffic platform of Bosch MPS for Indian highways. It combines RFID and FASTag reads, number-plate recognition, vehicle classification and sensors into one verified transaction, and it runs on a layered architecture from the roadside edge to back-office reconciliation. It is live on a national highway today and is designed to scale from one gantry to many corridors.

The Toll.OS play also covers intelligent traffic management and enforcement at junctions and corridors, and the integration of tolling with highway Advanced Traffic Management Systems (ATMS) as national highway authorities specify in their tenders. The Product Manager owns this play as a product: what is built, how it performs in the field, what it costs to run, and what it needs to win the next deployment.

 **Job Description**

**What the role owns**

**Product strategy and roadmap** - Own and evolve the roadmap across tolling (multi-lane free flow and plaza software), intelligent traffic management and enforcement, and integration with highway ATMS. Sequence work by customer need, economics, certification effort and regulatory readiness.

**Field learning into requirements** - Work from live deployments: recognition accuracy, manual validation rate, reconciliation gaps, notice and dispute failures, incident root causes. Turn each pattern into a prioritised backlog item with an owner.

**Recognition and sensor-fusion quality** - Define accuracy and confidence targets across RFID, number-plate recognition, vehicle classification and other sensors. Work with engineering and AI teams on model, camera and edge decisions, and lead make-or-buy choices on components.

**Interoperability, compliance and security** - Ensure the product meets national interoperability specifications for electronic toll collection, RFID and equipment standards, certification requirements, data protection, audit logging and retention. Work with Legal and Compliance on regulatory change.

**Tender and bid support** - Own the technical content of responses to highway authority and concessionaire tenders: compliance matrices, equivalence of components, architecture and service-level proposals. Work with Finance on bid-versus-investment discipline.

**Deployment and operations readiness** - Define site readiness, integration with acquirer banks and payment networks, settlement and reconciliation, service-level design and acceptance criteria. Hand over cleanly to operations and keep the live KPIs visible.

**Unit economics** - Own cost per passage and cost per plaza, and shape transaction-fee and service models with Finance, so the product stays competitive in price-led tenders.

**Ecosystem and partners** - Work with highway authorities, concessionaires, acquirer banks, system integrators and hardware vendors. Work with the Global Partner Manager on technology and supplier partnerships.

**Platform and data integration** - Publish passage and vehicle events into the Mobility Prism platform so the same vehicle can be understood across tolling, traffic and other services, within consent and data protection rules.

**Team and ways of working** - Guide the product owners and engineering squads working on Toll.OS using agile (SAFe) practices, and build the product-management discipline of the team through coaching and clear decision records

**How the role is measured**

The role is accountable for business outcomes, not only for product documentation. Effectiveness is assessed on:

* Recognition accuracy and share of passages verified without manual review
* Time from field issue to product fix
* Cost per passage and cost per plaza trend
* Technical compliance rate and win rate on tenders the role supported
* Deployment lead time from contract to go-live
* Reconciliation and settlement accuracy with acquirer banks
* Number of corridors and plazas running on the standard product
* Quality of field feedback captured into the roadmap

 **Qualifications**

**Who we are looking for**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering (electronics, electrical, computer science, civil or transportation); a master's degree or MBA is an advantage.

**Experience**

* 8 to 12+ years in product management, systems engineering or programme leadership in intelligent transport systems, electronic toll collection, smart-city or transport technology, payments infrastructure or computer-vision based systems.
* Has owned a product or system through design, certification, field deployment and operation, and has seen how it behaves when real traffic arrives.
* Experience in public-sector or regulated procurement (tenders, compliance matrices, service-level and performance guarantees) is strongly preferred.

**Domain and technical knowledge**

* Electronic toll collection: FASTag and national electronic toll collection specifications, RFID standards, acquirer and issuer roles, settlement and reconciliation.
* Number-plate recognition, computer vision and sensor fusion; understanding of accuracy metrics, confidence cascades and model monitoring.
* Edge computing, plaza and back-office systems, and integration through APIs; familiarity with traffic management and enforcement systems is an advantage.
* Certification, equipment standards, cybersecurity and data protection as they apply to roadside systems.
* Able to read an architecture, challenge a design and translate field problems into engineering requirements.

**Commercial skills**

* Unit economics, pricing and service-level commercials; comfortable with a P&L view of a product.
* Negotiation and relationship skills with authorities, banks and vendors.

**Personal attributes**

* Strong ownership and bias to action; comfortable operating with ambiguity in a new business.
* Field-minded: willing to spend time at sites and with operations teams, with regular domestic travel.
* Clear structured communicator, in writing and in the room, who can explain a technical trade-off to a senior stakeholder.
* Integrity and discretion when working with public authorities and sensitive data.
* Collaborative leader who influences without formal authority across engineering, business and partners.

 **Additional Information**

**Who the role works with**

* Product Area Leader for the UtilizationStack (MPS/PAZ)
* Engineering, AI and DevSecOps teams
* Delivery, site and operations teams
* Bid and tender team, and the Global Partner Manager
* Finance, Legal and Compliance
* Regional business leadership (MPS/RBR)
* Highway authorities, concessionaires, acquirer banks, system integrators and vendors
* Product owners for Mobility Prism and for financial services built on toll data

**How to read this role**

This is a product-ownership role with business accountability, not a project management or pure engineering role. The ideal candidate combines systems depth, field experience, commercial judgement and the ability to win trust with authorities and partners.

description:
**Powering the agentic revolution in travel.** Sabre is an AI-native technology leader, backed by one of the world’s largest travel data clouds. Built on an open, modular, cloud-native architecture, Sabre serves as the backbone for both established leaders and bold, new disruptors, guiding them to the next age of travel retailing through intelligent, connected, and personalized experiences. With AI at its core and operating at unparalleled scale, Sabre transforms insights into innovation, empowering airlines, hoteliers, agencies and other partners to retail, distribute and fulfill travel worldwide.

Job Description- Principal Product Manager

**1. Role Overview**  
The Principal Product Manager for Corporate Intelligence will lead the product strategy and evolution of PRISM, Sabre’s corporate travel intelligence and decision-support platform. The role sits at the intersection of airline corporate sales, travel data, analytics, contracting, APIs and AI, and requires a strong understanding of how airlines use corporate travel data to make commercial decisions. This leader will own the evolution of the portfolio from traditional reporting and analytics toward predictive and prescriptive intelligence, helping airline customers improve corporate sales performance, contract effectiveness, market share and return on invested discounts. The role requires senior-level product leadership to connect customer and market needs with technology, data and commercial strategy

**2. What THIS ROLE Will Do**  

* Define and drive the Corporate Intelligence product vision, strategy, investment priorities and multi-year roadmap, balancing customer commitments, platform modernization, competitive differentiation, revenue protection and new growth opportunities.

* Drive capabilities that will transform the product to predictive and prescriptive intelligence, including contract optimization, forecasting, scenario modeling, AI-assisted insights and intelligent recommendations.

* Partner directly with airline corporate sales, commercial and revenue teams to understand complex problems around corporate contracting, market share, account performance, discount effectiveness and revenue opportunities, then translate those needs into scalable product capabilities.

* Shape capabilities across data ingestion, data quality, APIs, analytics and integrations, including agency/TMC connectivity, NDC and direct channels, CRM integrations and the modernization of customer access to Corporate Intelligence data.

* Partner with Engineering, Data Science, AI, Commercial, Customer Care, Delivery and Data Governance teams to take capabilities from strategy through delivery and adoption. Support strategic customer engagements, renewals, RFPs and new-business opportunities while ensuring the roadmap remains scalable rather than customer-specific.

**3. What THIS ROLE Requires**

* 10+ years of relevant product, travel technology, airline commercial, data or analytics experience, including demonstrated ownership of complex B2B or enterprise software products. Experience operating at Principal Product Manager or equivalent strategic product-leadership level is strongly preferred.

* Deep airline and corporate travel domain knowledge, with a strong understanding of corporate sales and contracting, TMC/agency ecosystems, airline distribution, GDS/NDC/direct channels, ticketed travel data, O&D concepts, market share, corporate account performance and commercial analytics.

* Strong data and technical product acumen, with the ability to work effectively with APIs, data pipelines, cloud/data platforms, data-quality concepts, analytics, CRM integrations and large-scale transactional datasets. The candidate does not need to be an engineer, but must be capable of translating business problems into technically credible product requirements and architecture discussions.

* Advanced analytics and AI product understanding, including predictive analytics, optimization, machine learning and Generative AI. The role must be able to identify where AI can materially improve airline commercial decision-making while ensuring data quality, explainability, governance and human oversight.

* Strategic and commercial product leadership, with demonstrated experience developing product strategy, prioritizing roadmaps and investments, building business cases, supporting enterprise customers and RFPs, and aligning senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Commercial and customer organizations.

**4. Why Join Us**  
The role combines strategic product leadership with direct customer and commercial impact. You will work across Product, Engineering, Data Science, AI and Commercial teams and engage with airline customers. This is an opportunity to influence the broader evolution of Sabre’s Corporate Intelligence portfolio and how trusted data and AI are converted into measurable customer and business outcomes.

We will give careful consideration to your application and review your details against the position criteria. You will receive separate notification as your application progresses.

Please note that only candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role will proceed in the selection process.

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, or a STEM-related field, including Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics.

description:
**InMobi (Corporate)**

InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.

**InMobi Advertising**

InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.

**Glance**

Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

**About Accelerate:**  
Accelerate is InMobi's AI-native, self-serve campaign management platform for SMBs, D2C brands, agencies and enterprise advertisers. An advertiser describes their brand and goals; Accelerate's agents plan, create, launch and optimize campaigns across ad platforms such as TikTok and OpenAI, with more supply integrations on the way.  
We are building toward a fully autonomous marketing platform. This role sits on the demand side, reporting to the Group Product Manager for Customer Experience Core.  
  
**About the Role:**  
You will own Accelerate's growth engine: getting every advertiser from first visit to a live, performing campaign, and keeping them coming back. This is a Growth PM role with full ownership of user and retention metrics. You will design the journey for each persona, from an SMB owner who has never run an ad to an agency moving dozens of accounts from another tool. You will own signup, ad-account connection, migration of existing accounts and spend history, and the moments that turn a new user into an  
active one.You will run experiments, own the funnel numbers, and work closely with the Core Product Experience and Monetization teams, since activation depends on both a great first campaign and a smooth first payment.

**What you will own:**

* Persona journeys. End-to-end journeys for SMBs, D2C brands, agencies, mid-size advertisers and enterprise teams, from first visit to steady use. You define what "activated" means for each.
* Signup and account connection. Signup, business verification, connecting ad accounts on platforms like TikTok and OpenAI, and linking data sources such as pixels and product catalogs.
* Migration. Bringing existing ad accounts, campaigns and spend history into Accelerate, so advertisers keep their learnings and agencies can move clients in bulk.
* Activation. Time to first live campaign and first results. Includes AI-guided onboarding, where the agent helps users finish setup rather than leaving them with a checklist.
* Retention and lifecycle. Nudges, re-engagement, in-product guidance and email or WhatsApp lifecycle flows that bring users back and grow their usage.
* Experimentation. An experimentation practice for the funnel: hypotheses, A/B tests, analysis and decisions.
* Metrics. Signup-to-activation conversion, time to first live campaign, account connection success rate, week-4 and week-12 retention, and activation by persona and acquisition channel.

  

**What we're looking for:**

* 6+ years of product management, with at least 3 years as a Growth PM owning activation or retention metrics.
* Growth experience in a B2B or merchant-facing self-serve product (SMBs, sellers, restaurants, creators, developers). Consumer-only growth experience is not enough on its own.
* A track record of moving funnel metrics through experiments, with numbers you can explain: baseline, change, and why it worked.
* Strong analytical skills. You write your own SQL or work directly in product analytics tools, and you know when an experiment result is noise.
* Design sense for onboarding: you know how small details in a flow change conversion, and you partner with design as a peer.
* You work AI-native (see "How we work" below). You prototype, write and reason with LLMs as part of your daily work.
* Clear written communication and the ability to align engineering, design, marketing and customer success around a funnel goal.

**Strong pluses:**

* Experience with ad-platform account linking, OAuth integrations, or migrating users and data from a competing product.
* Built AI-guided or conversational onboarding in production.
* Experience with agency or multi-account onboarding.
* Experience with lifecycle tools and channels (email, push, WhatsApp) and the experimentation platforms behind them.
* Experience in martech or adtech, or time running performance marketing yourself.

**How we work:**  
Accelerate is an AI-native product, and we build it the AI-native way. Every PM on the demand side is expected to:

* Prototype before you spec. Turn an idea into a clickable prototype with AI tools in hours, and test it with users and the team before writing requirements.
* Write and think with LLMs. Draft PRDs, edge cases, test cases, and analyses with an LLM as a working partner. Then apply your own judgment to what it gets wrong.
* Hand off with less back-and-forth. Give engineering and design specs precise enough to build from, with prototypes and acceptance criteria attached, so fewer decisions get made in meetings.
* Stay close to the data. Pull and analyze data yourself rather than waiting on a dashboard request.
* Bring design sense. Care about the details of the customer experience and partner with design as a peer, not a requester. We will test this in the interview loop, not just ask about it.

Since 2007, InMobi has built the extraordinary. Beyond just technology. It has built a way of working.

Across 16 offices globally, through every pivot and breakthrough, one thing has remained constant: we are builders, dreamers, doers. We are fluid enough to move fast, grounded enough to own outcomes, and human enough to care deeply about the work and about one another.

Culture is at the core of that ethos. It has been co-created by the people who built this company and by those continuing to shape it every day. It lives in how we work, how decisions are made, how teams show up for one another, and how seriously we take the responsibility to build the best.

This is a place where ambition and belonging occupy the same space. Where the bar is high and the support is real. Where freedom comes with trust, and trust comes with accountability. Where you are valued not only for what you do, but for the perspective, judgment and humanity you bring to the work. Where you will be challenged by the work and supported by the communities, passions and experiences that shape who you are beyond your role.

If this sounds like the place you have been looking for, join us.

Find out more here: InMobi Culture

**About Tekion:**

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

**About Tekion**  
  
Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform. Our platform spans the Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, the Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises, and the Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform, using cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to bring together vehicle manufacturers, dealerships, and consumers. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia, and Europe.
  
  
**About the Role**
  
  
Tekion connects dealerships - the businesses that sell and service vehicles - with the automakers that build those vehicles, such as General Motors, Honda, or Ford. Across the industry these automakers are referred to as OEMs (Original Equipment Manufacturers). The software on each side needs to exchange information automatically and reliably: vehicle orders, inventory, repair records, customer details, and much more. The software that makes this exchange happen is called integration. We are seeking a driven, technically curious Product Manager I to join our Integrations team. You will take ownership of one integration pattern - a family of similar integrations that share the same shape (for example, all the integrations that send vehicle service and repair data to automakers). Your mission is to make every integration in that family measurably healthy and best-in-class, shift more of its delivery from manual building to AI-assisted building, and make sure dealerships actually adopt and benefit from it. This is a hands-on role for an early-career product manager who is comfortable with technical concepts, motivated by measurable outcomes, and excited to help modernize how a decades-old industry connects its software. You will work closely with Engineering, Design, and senior product managers, who will guide and mentor you as you grow into full ownership of your integration pattern.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
  
  

* Keep your integrations healthy and best-in-class: Define what “good” looks like for your integration pattern, measure it in our Integration Platform (Tekion’s internal health-monitoring system), and drive coverage, reliability, and quality up across all your integrations - benchmarking each against the best competing product in the market.

  

* Win on AI-powered delivery: Shift your pattern from hand-built integrations toward ones generated with Tekion’s AI-assisted build tools (internally, APC Studio), help sharpen the AI tools you depend on, and own a complete, living set of requirements that any engineering team can build from.

  

* Drive revenue through OEM certifications: Lead integration patterns toward successful OEM certification so OEM-approved integrations can be adopted by dealers at scale. Drive adoption and reduce support load: Make your integrations easy to install and switch on, raise dealership uptake where it is low, and reduce support tickets by tracking and fixing root causes.

  

* Partner across teams: Translate the needs of dealers, automakers, and partners into clear requirements, and work day-to-day with Engineering, Design, Support, and Go-to-Market teams to deliver, launch, and measure impact.

  
**What We’re Looking For**
  
  

* Around 3+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience in a technical product, integration, API, or platform role. Strong early-career candidates with a technical background are encouraged to apply.

  

* Exposure to integrations, APIs, or platform and marketplace products, with the ability to read technical documentation and discuss APIs, webhooks, and data flows with engineers. (An API is a defined way for two systems to exchange data; a webhook is an automatic notification one system sends another when something happens. You do not need to write code.)

  

* A strong bias toward measurable outcomes, with comfort using dashboards, metrics, and data to set targets and track progress.

  
• Clear writing skills - the ability to turn messy, ambiguous requirements into crisp specifications and user stories. • Curiosity about AI and how it can automate technical work, plus the drive to improve the tools you use.
  
  

* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work with both technical and non-technical audiences.

  

* The ability to manage ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and make thoughtful trade-offs in a fast-paced environment.

  

* A bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  
**Nice to Have**
  
  

* Interest in or exposure to AI agents, large language models (LLMs), and automated workflows.

  

* Familiarity with the automotive retail world - dealerships, the Dealer Management System (DMS, the core software a dealership runs its business on), or automaker (OEM) certification programs.

  
**Why Join Us**  
  

* Modernize an industry: Help modernize how an entire industry connects its software, moving from slow, hand-built integrations to a fast, AI-powered delivery model.

  

* Work at the frontier of AI delivery: Be hands-on with how AI is used to scope, build, and test real enterprise integrations.

  

* See measurable impact: Own clear, measurable goals and watch your work show up directly in integration health, adoption, and support metrics.

  

* Grow with mentorship: Learn from senior product managers and engineers, with a clear path to grow into broader ownership.

**About ePS Packaging**

At ePS Packaging, we’re shaping the future of packaging through technology. As a global leader in industry-specific business and production software, we help packaging companies streamline operations, boost efficiency, and unlock growth.

With over 30 years of experience, a global footprint, and a deep understanding of the packaging industry, we believe one thing above all: our success grows when our customers thrive.

**Core responsibilities:**

The Product Owner is the execution arm of the product team and is accountable for translating product direction, roadmap initiatives, and customer needs into clearly defined, prioritised, and deliverable work for Agile development teams. The role owns the product backlog and sprint-level execution, ensuring that development teams understand what needs to be built, why it matters, and how successful delivery will be validated.

**Core responsibilities:**

Product Backlog and Prioritization

* Own, maintain, groom, and prioritise the product backlog, ensuring alignment with product goals, customer needs, business value, and delivery dependencies.
* Lead backlog refinement and ensure items are clearly defined, appropriately sized, prioritised, and ready for development.
* Assess feature requests, enhancements, defects, and competing demands; recommend sequencing and trade-offs in collaboration with the Product Manager.

  

Requirements and User Stories

* Translate roadmap initiatives and customer or business needs into epics, user stories, workflows, business rules, and clear acceptance criteria.
* Break down complex initiatives into manageable increments that can be delivered and validated through Agile sprints.
* Clarify functional behaviour, use cases, edge cases, and dependencies for Engineering and QA.
* Review completed work against acceptance criteria and confirm whether the agreed requirements have been met.

  

Agile Delivery and Team Enablement

* Work as the product domain expert and primary point of contact for the development team on backlog scope and requirement clarification.
* Participate actively in sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and other relevant Agile ceremonies; support the team in maintaining sprint-level momentum.
* Monitor sprint goals, backlog readiness, scope changes, and cross-team dependencies, escalating risks through the appropriate channels.
* Partner with Engineering and QA to support feature validation, quality, and delivery against agreed priorities.

Customer and Stakeholder Collaboration

* Work with Product Managers and relevant customer-facing teams to understand customer feedback and translate it into actionable product backlog items.
* Drive early feedback on new features and incorporate validated insights into backlog refinement and prioritization.
* Communicate priorities, scope decisions, requirement changes, and delivery expectations clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.
* Build alignment where stakeholders have competing needs, using product priorities and customer value to guide recommendations.

Continuous Improvement and Senior-Level Contribution

* Identify opportunities to improve story quality, backlog health, team collaboration, and product delivery practices.
* Use delivery and quality feedback to identify recurring requirement gaps, reduce avoidable rework, and improve sprint readiness.
* Share product domain knowledge and provide guidance or mentorship to less experienced Product Owners and team members, where applicable.

Role Focus and Responsibility Boundaries

* Maintain focus on product backlog ownership, requirement clarity, and sprint-level product execution in alignment with the Product Manager/CPO.
* Tier 2 support and technical triage are owned by Support/DevOps teams; project management and Scrum Master responsibilities by Delivery roles; customer demos and training by Enablement/Presales; and code contribution by Development teams.
* Other duties as assigned.

* 8+ years of experience in Product Ownership, product delivery, software product development, or a closely related role, with substantial hands-on Product Owner experience.
* Mandatory: Relevant experience in the Packaging industry/domain, with specific exposure to CLF (Cartons, Labels & Flexibles). Understanding of packaging workflows, products, and industry-specific business processes is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience owning and prioritizing product backlogs for software products, ideally within a global SaaS or enterprise software environment.

Own the assigned product portfolio from market discovery and emerging product

sourcing.

##### **Key responsibilities**

**Market research and stakeholder engagement:**

* Conduct structured market surveys, customer interviews and site visits to identify
    
  unmet needs, buying criteria and deployment challenges.
* Engage customers to understand operational needs, consultants to understand
    
  specification and compliance expectations, and Master System Integrators (MSIs)
    
  to assess integration and deployment requirements.
* Work with Sales and Presales to validate demand and consolidate feedback from
    
  active opportunities, tenders, demos and deployments.

**Emerging markets and new product identification:**

* Track emerging technologies, applications and procurement trends across Smart
    
  & Safe Cities, intelligent traffic management, video analytics and enterprise
    
  security.
* Identify new hardware, software and integrated product opportunities, including
    
  adjacent markets where Vehant can build on its existing technology, customer
    
  relationships or channel partnerships.
* Validate shortlisted opportunities with customers, consultants and MSIs.
    
  Establish the target buyer, problem to solve, willingness to pay and likely route to
    
  market.
* Build business cases covering demand, revenue potential, differentiation,
    
  technical feasibility, development and sourcing costs, certification requirements
    
  and time to market.
* Recommend whether to build, source or partner. Define measurable pilot success
    
  criteria for approved concepts.

**Competition analysis and product differentiation:**

* Benchmark competing products on functionality, field performance, integration,
    
  certifications, pricing and total cost of ownership.
* Use competitive gaps and customer feedback to define new unique selling
    
  propositions (USPs) with measurable customer benefits.
* Validate proposed USPs through comparative testing, demonstrations or field
    
  pilots and equip Sales and Presales with the evidence to communicate them.

**Product roadmap and specification finalisation:**

* Own and prioritise the hardware and software roadmap based on customer
    
  demand, commercial potential, technical feasibility and resource availability.
* Finalise product specifications with Development, Technical, IT and Quality
    
  teams. Cover performance, interfaces, interoperability, cybersecurity,
    
  environmental conditions and deployment constraints as applicable
* Define measurable acceptance criteria and secure cross-functional sign-off before
    
  development or sourcing commitments. Assess the cost, schedule and compliance
    
  impact of subsequent specification changes.

**Cross-functional execution, launch and lifecycle management:**

* Work with Sales and Presales on positioning and opportunity feedback,
    
  Development on feasibility and release delivery, Technical and Service teams on
    
  field validation and supportability, and IT on infrastructure, cybersecurity and
    
  deployment readiness.
* Coordinate prototypes, proofs of concept, field trials and release readiness
    
  reviews. Resolve dependencies and escalate decisions that affect scope, cost or
    
  timelines.
* Drive launch readiness through datasheets, compliance matrices, demonstrations,
    
  release notes and training for Sales, Presales and Service.
* Track adoption, field performance and recurring service issues. Use the findings
    
  to prioritise enhancements, upgrades and end-of-life decisions.

**Certifications, testing and compliance:**

* Identify applicable standards, certifications and tender-related compliance
    
  requirements for each product. Incorporate them into specifications, test plans
    
  and release schedules
* Coordinate testing and documentation with Development, Quality, vendors and
    
  external laboratories or certification agencies. Track gaps, corrective actions, test
    
  evidence and approvals through closure.
* Maintain a product-wise compliance matrix and track certificate validity,
    
  renewals and the impact of hardware, firmware or software changes on existing
    
  approvals.

**Vendor communication and sourcing optimisation:**

* Lead product and technical discussions with OEMs, component suppliers and
    
  technology partners. Evaluate samples, capabilities, customisation options and
    
  support commitments.
* Work with Procurement, Development and Quality to optimise bill-of-materials
    
  cost and lead times, qualify alternate sources and reduce single-source
    
  dependencies.
* Validate sourcing changes against agreed specifications, field reliability, warranty
    
  implications and certification requirements before approval.

**Monthly management review and reporting:**

* Prepare and circulate a monthly product report covering emerging product
    
  opportunities, market and competitor developments, roadmap milestones,
    
  specification sign-offs, pilots, certification status, sourcing metrics, risks and
    
  decisions required.
* Lead the monthly management review. Present options, trade-offs and a
    
  recommendation for each decision on which opportunities to pursue, defer or
    
  close, along with decisions on roadmap priorities, investment, specification
    
  changes, certification spend, vendor selection and launch readiness.
* Record decisions, action owners and due dates. Track actions to closure and
    
  escalate blockers that require attention before the next review.

##### **Experience & Qualifications**

* 10–12 years of experience in B2B technology, with demonstrated ownership of
    
  hardware and software products or integrated solutions.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline. An MBA is
    
  desirable.
* Experience in intelligent traffic systems, smart or safe cities, surveillance, AI
    
  video analytics, industrial IoT or embedded systems is preferred.

* Proven ability to identify and validate new market opportunities and take
    
  products from specification through pilot, certification, launch and post-launch
    
  review.
* Experience engaging customers, consultants and system integrators and
    
  translating their inputs into product and commercial decisions.
* Working knowledge of vendor qualification, product costing, alternate sourcing
    
  and compliance documentation.
* Ability to influence cross-functional teams and present concise, evidence-based
    
  recommendations to senior management.

description:
**About the Team**

Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.

Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us.

We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.

But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs, to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who is passionate about solving high impact problems in a fast paced start-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category mgmt., marketing, operations, finance, etc to bring a new product to life.

### **What will you do**

* Market & Customer Understanding: Understand the e-commerce market and needs of customers/sellers deeply through landscape analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
* Problem Identification & Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.
* Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology-led ideas to solve the prioritized problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engg., business, etc. Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.
* Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross-functional team (design, engineering, business, analytics, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.
* Go-to-Market Planning: Create a go-to-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
* Adoption & Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
* Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3-month forward looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.
* Team Leadership: Manage a small team of product analysts and associate product managers, and guide them towards product execution.

### **What you will need**

* Overall experience of 7+ yrs with atleast 5+ yrs in product management in a tech-led company (consumer internet space is preferred)
* Exceptional problem solving skills based on first principles thinking
* Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps

### **About us**

Welcome to Meesho, where every story begins with a spark of inspiration and a dash of entrepreneurial spirit. We're not just a platform; we're your partner in turning dreams into realities.

**Curious about life at Meesho? Explore our Glassdoor - our people have a lot to say and they've helped us become a loved workplace in India.**

### **Our Mission**

Democratising internet commerce for everyone — Meesho (Meri Shop) started with a single idea in mind: to be an e-commerce destination for Indian consumers and to enable small businesses to succeed online.

We provide our sellers with benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping solutions in the market. Today, sellers nationwide are growing their businesses by tapping into Meesho’s large and diverse customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, and pan-India logistics network through trusted third-party partners.

Affordable, relatable merchandise that mirrors local markets has helped us connect with internet users and serve customers across urban, semi-urban, and rural India. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have established us as a part of India’s e-commerce ecosystem.

### **Culture and Total Rewards**

Our focus is on cultivating a dynamic workplace characterized by high impact and performance excellence. We prioritize a people-centric culture, dedicated to hiring and developing exceptional talent.

Total rewards at Meesho comprise a comprehensive set of elements — monetary, non-monetary, tangible, and intangible. description:
**InMobi (Corporate)**

InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.

**InMobi Advertising**

InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.

**Glance**

Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

**About Accelerate:**  
Accelerate is InMobi's AI-native, self-serve campaign management platform for SMBs, D2C brands, agencies and enterprise advertisers. An advertiser describes their brand and goals; Accelerate's agents plan, create, launch and optimize campaigns across ad platforms such as TikTok and OpenAI, with more supply integrations on the way.  
We are building toward a fully autonomous marketing platform. The product team is organized by capability, not segment. This role sits on the demand side, reporting to the Group Product Manager, alongside Customer Experience Core (campaign creation, onboarding and activation).  
  
**About the role:**  
You will build Accelerate's payments and money infrastructure from zero. Every dollar or rupee an advertiser puts into Accelerate flows through what you build: how they fund their account, how spend is drawn down across ad platforms, how they are invoiced, refunded and taxed, and how we settle with suppliers.  
There is no legacy system to inherit. You will define the wallet, the ledger behind it, and the integration with our third-party payments partner (Vyre), then own the revenue metrics that depend on them. Getting this right is what lets an SMB go from signup to live campaign in minutes, and what lets finance trust every number on the dashboard.  
You will work with a Senior Product Associate on the pod, engineering, Central Design, and InMobi finance, tax and legal teams.

**What you will own:**

* Advertiser wallet. A prepaid balance advertisers top up and Accelerate draws down as campaigns spend. Includes funding methods, auto-recharge, low-balance alerts, credit lines for larger accounts, and the rules for how a balance can and cannot be used.
* Ledger and reconciliation. The source of truth for every credit, debit, hold, refund and adjustment. Spend reported by each ad platform must reconcile to the ledger, with clear handling for mismatches.
* Payments integration. End-to-end integration with Vyre, our third-party payments partner: collections, payment methods, failures and retries, webhooks, and the fallback plan if a provider is down.
* Billing, invoicing and tax. Invoices, receipts, GST, TDS on ad spend, and multi-currency handling as we add international advertisers.
* Supplier settlement. How we pay out and reconcile with ad platforms, working with the business team that handles supplier contracts.
* Segment needs. SMBs prepaying by card or UPI, agencies funding many client accounts from one place, and enterprise clients on invoiced terms.
* Revenue metrics. Top-up conversion, payment success rate, time to first funded campaign, wallet balance retention, and reconciliation accuracy. Every revenue number in Accelerate's success framework depends on your system.

**What we're looking for:**

* 6+ years of product management, with at least 3 years owning payments, wallets, billing or ledger systems.
* You have built a payments or wallet system from scratch, or led its first major version. Scaling a mature system alone is not enough.
* Deep understanding of double-entry ledgers, idempotency, reconciliation, refunds and chargebacks. You can sit with engineers and discuss failure modes, not just flows.
* Hands-on experience integrating a third-party payment provider or aggregator end to end.
* Working knowledge of Indian payments regulation and tax: RBI rules on prepaid instruments, GST, TDS. You know when to bring in legal and what to ask them.
* You work AI-native (see "How we work" below). You prototype, write and reason with LLMs as part of your daily work.
* Clear written communication. You can explain a ledger design to an engineer, a finance controller and an SMB owner, each in their own terms.  
  Strong pluses
* You built a wallet or stored-balance feature inside a non-fintech product, such as a marketplace, mobility, food delivery or SaaS platform.
* Experience with ad-platform billing (prepaid, postpaid or credit-line models) or marketplace payouts.
* Experience with cross-border payments, multi-currency balances or FX.
* Experience with B2B billing for agencies or multi-entity accounts.
* Some time as an engineer, or comfort reading API docs and querying data directly.

**How we work:**  
Accelerate is an AI-native product, and we build it the AI-native way. Every PM on the demand side is expected to:

* Prototype before you spec. Turn an idea into a clickable prototype with AI tools in hours, and test it with users and the team before writing requirements.
* Write and think with LLMs. Draft PRDs, edge cases, test cases and analyses with an LLM as a working partner. Then apply your own judgment to what it gets wrong.
* Hand off with less back-and-forth. Give engineering and design specs precise enough to build from, with prototypes and acceptance criteria attached, so fewer decisions get made in meetings.
* Stay close to the data. Pull and analyze data yourself rather than waiting on a dashboard request.
* Bring design sense. Care about the details of the customer experience and partner with design as a peer, not a requester. We will test this in the interview loop, not just ask about it.

Since 2007, InMobi has built the extraordinary. Beyond just technology. It has built a way of working.

Across 16 offices globally, through every pivot and breakthrough, one thing has remained constant: we are builders, dreamers, doers. We are fluid enough to move fast, grounded enough to own outcomes, and human enough to care deeply about the work and about one another.

Culture is at the core of that ethos. It has been co-created by the people who built this company and by those continuing to shape it every day. It lives in how we work, how decisions are made, how teams show up for one another, and how seriously we take the responsibility to build the best.

This is a place where ambition and belonging occupy the same space. Where the bar is high and the support is real. Where freedom comes with trust, and trust comes with accountability. Where you are valued not only for what you do, but for the perspective, judgment and humanity you bring to the work. Where you will be challenged by the work and supported by the communities, passions and experiences that shape who you are beyond your role.

If this sounds like the place you have been looking for, join us.

Find out more here: InMobi Culture

description:
**About the Role**

We're looking for an Associate Product Manager with 1–2 years of experience who is excited about building user-focused products and solving real customer problems. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and Business teams to take ideas from discovery to execution and continuously improve the product experience.

This role is ideal for someone who is analytical, curious, highly execution-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

Location: Vasant Kunj, Delhi - Hybrid

**What you'll do**

*Understand the problem*

* Talk to users regularly. Run interviews, sit in on support and sales calls, watch people use the product, and read the feedback nobody else reads.
* Separate what users ask for from what they actually need, and turn scattered input into a clear, prioritized problem list.
* Bring evidence, not opinions. Every proposal should trace back to something a real user said or did.

*Build and design*

* Turn ideas into clickable prototypes using AI tools like Claude, Lovable, or whatever gets you to a real interaction fastest, so users, stakeholders, engineers, and QA can all experience the thing before it's built.
* Design the experience end to end: the main flow, the empty states, the error messages, the edge cases.
* Use AI to multiply your output. Synthesizing research, building internal tools, analyzing data, testing ideas in an afternoon instead of a sprint.
* Help ship AI-powered features, and think hard about what happens when the model gets it wrong.

*Own delivery*

* Keep a clear, prioritized backlog for your area. Be able to explain why something is next, including what you're not doing and why.
* Write short and plainly: the problem, the user, one success metric, what's in scope and what isn't.
* Work with engineering and QA through backlog grooming, sprint planning, and QA. Answer questions, resolve ambiguity, test the release yourself before it ships.
* Help plan and run launches with the people who need to know: support, sales, marketing, and leadership.

**What we're looking for**

* **A portfolio we can open:** Projects, tools, prototypes, or products you've built.
* **User curiosity:** You open an app and can't help asking why people keep coming back to it, and what you'd steal.
* **AI fluency:** You've gone past basic prompting. You know how to give a model the right context, you've seen where models fail, and you've thought about what to do about it.
* **Taste:** Shown two versions of a screen, you can say which is better and explain why in terms of the user. You notice layout, hierarchy, spacing, and what a screen does when it's empty or broken.
* **Comfort with data:** You can pull numbers out of a sheet or a dashboard, spot when something looks off, and back a conclusion with them.
* **Clear thinking under ambiguity:** You can break a vague problem into something testable.
* **Strong communication:** You can explain a decision to an engineer, a designer, and a business stakeholder without changing the substance.
* **Attention to detail:** In the product, and in your own work.

**Nice to have**

* You've written an eval, or tuned LLM model settings and can say what changed.
* Fluency in Figma, or formal design training.
* Hands-on time with an analytics tool (Mixpanel, Amplitude, Metabase, GA).
* A side project with real users you didn't have to recruit.
* Interest in education, careers, or working with students.

No MBA required. No prior PM title required. If you're short on experience, product depth and the drive to build make up for it. What matters is what you've built.
